Integration Developer

Client: Government / Enterprise Client
Location: Remote
Salary: $110,000–$120,000 annually, based on experience and technical interview
Employment Type: Full-Time
Citizenship: U.S. Citizen Required

Keywords: Integration Developer, Integration Engineer, API Developer, Backend Developer, Systems Integration, Azure, AWS, GCP, Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, REST API, SOAP, GraphQL, OAuth2, JWT, API Security, MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong, Workato, BizTalk, Event-Driven Architecture, Message Queues, Pub/Sub, iPaaS, ESB, CI/CD, Cloud Integration, Data Transformation

Position Overview

Fathom Management is seeking an experienced Integration Developer to design, develop, and support scalable integrations across enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and cloud environments.

The successful candidate will combine strong backend development and API integration skills with an understanding of modern integration architecture and cloud technologies. This position will work across the full integration lifecycle-from design and development through testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.

This is an excellent opportunity for an Integration Developer, Integration Engineer, API Developer, or Backend Developer who enjoys solving complex integration challenges and connecting internal and third-party systems through reliable, secure, and scalable solutions.

Candidate Verification Notice

For your protection and ours, Fathom Management conducts a brief candidate verification at the beginning of the screening process. Because we support State and Federal Government clients, this verification helps protect your identity, résumé, and application from unauthorized use and confirms that we are speaking directly with the individual who applied for the position.

You may be asked to provide a photo of a government-issued identification document as part of this verification. Video verification may also be required.

Identification is used solely for candidate verification and will be handled in accordance with Fathom Management's privacy and security practices.

Current Technical ArchitectureDevelopment Experience

Candidates should demonstrate recent hands-on experience with several of the following:

Backend services and API development using Python, Java, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript
Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud environments
RESTful APIs and other API technologies, including SOAP and/or GraphQL
Enterprise integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong, Workato, BizTalk, or comparable technologies
Integration patterns including event-driven, pub/sub, hub-and-spoke, point-to-point, ESB, and iPaaS
API security including OAuth2, JWT, SAML, and API keys
Message queues, asynchronous processing, and event streaming
Data mapping, transformation, orchestration, and exchange across heterogeneous systems
CI/CD pipelines and multi-environment deployments
Required Qualifications
3+ years of hands-on software development experience using one or more modern programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and architectural styles.
Hands-on experience designing and developing APIs and system integrations.
Experience with RESTful services, SOAP, and/or GraphQL.
Working knowledge of API security, authentication, authorization, versioning, throttling/rate limiting, and error handling.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform: Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Solid understanding of data mapping, transformation, orchestration, and integration across disparate systems.
Experience across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including development, testing, CI/CD, and deployment.
Experience supporting deployments across multiple environments, such as Development, Test, UAT, and Production.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and ability to collaborate with technical and cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Experience with one or more enterprise integration platforms, including:
MuleSoft
Apigee
Kong
Workato
BizTalk
Experience with Azure integration services and cloud-native architecture.
Experience with message queues, event streaming, or pub/sub technologies.
Experience supporting enterprise API management.
Experience with automated testing and CI/CD practices.
Experience supporting production integration environments.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop end-to-end integration solutions spanning backend services, APIs, integration layers, and cloud infrastructure.
Build scalable backend services and APIs using modern programming languages and/or enterprise integration platforms.
Design and implement secure RESTful and enterprise APIs connecting internal and third-party systems.
Apply appropriate integration patterns, including event-driven, asynchronous, pub/sub, ESB, and iPaaS architectures.
Implement API security, authentication, authorization, versioning, throttling, and error-handling standards.
Develop data mapping, transformation, and orchestration solutions across heterogeneous systems.
Build, test, and deploy integration processes throughout the Dev, Test, UAT, and Production lifecycle.
Support CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
Monitor integration performance, troubleshoot issues, and provide post-deployment production support.
Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical specifications, data mappings, configuration documentation, and other technical artifacts.
Collaborate with developers, architects, business stakeholders, and other technical teams to optimize data flows and integration solutions.
Establish and follow integration development standards, design patterns, and best practices.
What Makes Someone Successful

The successful candidate will be:

Hands-on and technically capable
Strong in API and systems integration
Comfortable working across cloud and enterprise environments
Experienced troubleshooting production integrations
Security-minded when designing APIs and data exchanges
Analytical and solutions-oriented
Comfortable working with both modern development technologies and established enterprise integration platforms
Collaborative and able to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders
Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines
Benefits Overview

Fathom Management offers full-time employees a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including:

Paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Life insurance
Short- and long-term disability
401(k) retirement plan
Military leave
Professional training and development
Tuition reimbursement
Employee wellness program
Commuter benefits
And more
